abstract:
PURPOSE: Patients undergoing pancreatoduodenectomy for periampullary malignancies are at high nutritional risk. The aim was to characterize longitudinal changes in reported dietary intake, clinical-nutritional biomarkers, and inflammatory-nutritional indices after surgery and contextualize them through cross-sectional comparisons with age- and sex-similar controls.
METHODS: This prospective longitudinal cohort included 24 patients and 20 contextual controls. Patients were assessed preoperatively and at 3 and 6 months after discharge; controls were assessed once. Dietary intake was estimated using an adapted food frequency questionnaire (FFQ). FFQ-reported energy surplus was intake minus the 25 kcal/kg/day requirement based on the European Society for Clinical Nutrition and Metabolism (ESPEN). Longitudinal analyses, contextual comparisons, and exploratory adjusted diet-biomarker regressions were performed.
RESULTS: Of 24 patients assessed preoperatively, 18 and 16 were reassessed at 3 and 6 months. Median reported energy intake decreased from 2625 to 2011 and 1948 kcal/day, respectively. FFQ-reported energy surplus and intakes of macronutrients, fiber, calcium, iron, and selenium decreased, whereas zinc and vitamins A and E showed no detected longitudinal change. C-reactive protein, ferritin, liver enzymes, and serum vitamin E decreased. Glasgow Prognostic Score (GPS) and C-reactive protein-to-albumin ratio (CAR) decreased, the C-reactive protein-albumin-lymphocyte (CALLY) index increased, and the Prognostic Nutritional Index (PNI) showed no detected longitudinal change. Diet-biomarker associations were limited and inconsistent, although iron intake was positively associated with hemoglobin preoperatively in both adjusted models.
CONCLUSION: During the first 6 months after pancreatoduodenectomy, reduced reported dietary intake persisted despite attenuation of systemic inflammation, while biochemical and inflammatory-nutritional indices followed divergent trajectories. These trajectories describe patients alive and available for follow-up.
key_points_ko: 환자들의 일일 에너지 섭취량 중앙값은 수술 전 2625 kcal에서 3개월 후 2011 kcal, 6개월 후 1948 kcal로 지속해서 감소했습니다.
다량영양소, 식이섬유, 칼슘, 철, 셀레늄의 섭취량이 감소한 반면 아연과 비타민 A, E 섭취량은 유의한 변화를 보이지 않았습니다.
수술 후 C-반응성 단백(CRP)과 글래스고 예후 점수(GPS) 등 염증 지표는 감소했으나, 식사 섭취 저하는 6개월 동안 지속되었습니다.
summary_ko: 팽대부 주위 악성종양으로 췌십이지장절제술을 받은 환자 24명을 대상으로 수술 전과 퇴원 후 3개월, 6개월 시점의 식이 섭취량과 영양 바이오마커의 변화를 추적 관찰했습니다. 수술 후 전신 염증 수치는 전반적으로 완화되었으나, 에너지 및 주요 영양소의 섭취량 감소는 수술 후 6개월까지 지속되었습니다. 환자들의 에너지 섭취량 중앙값은 수술 전 하루 2625 kcal에서 6개월 후 1948 kcal로 감소했습니다. 연구진은 수술 후 전신 염증 완화와 무관하게 식이 섭취 감소가 장기간 이어질 수 있으므로 면밀한 영양 관리가 필요함을 확인했습니다.
title: A prospective cohort study of dietary intake and clinical-nutritional biomarkers in patients with periampullary malignancies undergoing pancreatoduodenectomy in Southeast Brazil
title_ko: 췌십이지장절제술을 받은 팽대부 주위 악성종양 환자의 식이 섭취량 및 임상·영양 바이오마커에 관한 전향적 코호트 연구
